_note: Input to tools/build-kanji.mjs and tools/build-strokes.mjs.
`grade1` is derived, not listed: KANJIDIC2 already knows which 80 kanji are
grade 1, so hand-listing them here would be a second source of truth that
goes stale. `numbers` and `days` are hand-ordered because teaching order is
not a property of the dictionary.
`slice` is [from, to], a half-open range over a set's teaching order. Grade
2 is 160 characters, which is two chapters' worth of rungs, so it is taught
as `grade2a` [0, 80] and `grade2b` [80, 160] rather than as one 160 row.
The two rows must cover the grade exactly and may not overlap;
build-kanji.mjs asserts both and prints the sum, because a slice that runs
short emits a file with characters missing from the middle of its ladder.
`kana` is the 176 codepoints U+3041 to U+3096 and U+30A1 to U+30FA. KanjiVG
ships all 176, HEAD-checked by the research report and re-checked by
build-strokes.mjs on every run.

sets.literals: 一二三四五六七八九十百千万円
日月火水木金土曜年時分半今毎週

_note: Input to tools/build-phon.mjs. It groups the whole joyo by the phonetic
component KanjiVG records in kvg:phon, so nothing here lists a member: a
hand-listed group would be a second source of truth for a fact the SVGs
already carry, and it would go stale the next time KanjiVG re-releases.
What is listed is the thresholds, because those are teaching decisions.
`taught_sets` names the sets whose characters the learner has already met,
which is what `known` means and what an anchor is. `min_group` is 3 because
two characters sharing a part is a coincidence, not a pattern.
`min_distinct_on` is the floor the drill needs: choice draws its wrong
options from the answers of other items in the same pool, so a pool with
three readings in it cannot offer three wrong ones.

kana_set.out_note: CONTRACTS C11.1 and data/README.md both name this file kana/strokes.json, and CONTRACTS C1.2 and C3.1 point at that path. PLAN's ownership table gives data/kana/** to workstream Ca and data/kanji/** to Cb, and Cb owns the KanjiVG pipeline, so the contract and the ownership table disagree about one file. Cb emitted it inside its own tree and asked delivery-lead to rule. Moving it is this one line plus a re-run; no code changes.
kana_set.extra_note: U+30FC, the long vowel mark. It is not in the two kana ranges, so the research report's verified 176 of 176 stays exactly 176. It is added by name because a katakana chapter that cannot show the stroke for the bar in koohii has a hole in it. KanjiVG ships it as kanji/030fc.svg.
